name: Resolute Rightgrip
description: Settle with the staff slanted and qi resting in the shoulders, ready to launch a chain of three strikes.

name: Rushing Block
description: Open the chain with a quick jab that draws the opponent's guard high and leaves the ribs uncovered.

name: Blockscorer
description: Whip the rear end up and across from the jab's recoil to strike the temple from the outside line.

name: Veering Tipcap
description: Take a half step into the third strike so the staff's end lands ahead of the advancing body.

name: Woven Spinbreak
description: Run jab, whip and drop as one unbroken line, with qi passing from hands to tip on every beat.

name: Lurching Roll
description: Cut an opponent's counter short with a sharp rap on the gripping hand, spoiling the reply before it forms.

name: Stalwart Staffcentre
description: Stand with the staff angled across the front, one hand high and one low, covering head and hip together.

name: Rooted Leftgrip
description: Raise the shaft flat above the head and meet an overhead cut at its middle, wrists locked firm.

name: Stubborn Roundstaff
description: Drop one end to the ground beside the knee so the shaft stops a low kick or sweep.

name: Layered Taperend
description: Slap the near end inward against an opposing arm or blade, turning the attack across the opponent's own body.

name: Stern Pivot
description: Use the parry's rebound to throw the same end straight into the chest, with no pause between.

name: Fleet Balancenode
description: Move the guard foot a short pace outward while holding the shaft in place, widening the angle of defence.

name: Padded Whitewood
description: Wheel the staff around the incoming blow so it slides off the shaft, and finish with the far end to the ribs.

name: Binding Sweepstep
description: Yield the guard a half pace under pressure so the opponent overreaches, then lock the shaft against their arm.

name: Resolute Bostip
description: Hold the staff with one palm open beneath the shaft so it can swivel freely to meet a weapon.

name: Rollslap
description: Turn the staff's end like a knuckle against the wrist of a reaching hand, jolting it loose.

name: Padded Balancenode
description: Slide the shaft under an opposing blade and lift it clear of the body with a small upward heave.

name: Fleet Leftgrip
description: Take one pace forward as the catch is made so the opponent's weapon stays pinned beside the body.

name: Tipcapscorer
description: Hook the near end behind the opponent's lead ankle and tug sharply backward to unseat the stance.

name: Burdening Sweepstep
description: Wrap the shaft around an opposing weapon's haft and pull it across the body, binding it for a breath.

name: Whitewood Hasp
description: Turn a caught weapon past the opponent's centre as the feet step through, spilling their balance forward.

name: Solid Roundstaff
description: Stand with the staff at forty-five degrees before the body and qi settled low, a guard that tires slowly.

name: Fierce Bogrip
description: Shoot the staff forward on a pulse of qi and recover it before the opponent can grasp.

name: Brawnroll
description: Swing the end in a short horizontal arc to slap the opponent's cheek or jaw from the side.

name: Bogriphasp
description: Lower the staff upright by the shin to check a kick, taking the impact on the wood rather than the leg.

name: Roll Stalk
description: Cross the rear foot behind the lead for a moment to angle sharply left or right, staff always forward.

name: Gleambostip
description: Tuck the staff under the arm and thrust it through the gap beside the opponent's raised weapon.

name: Rooted Tipcap
description: Brush the staff backward along the forearm in short strokes to turn a flurry of cuts away from the body.

name: Humbogrip
description: Roll the shaft over the opponent's arm to push the blow low, and answer with the upper end to the neck.

name: Sleet Block
description: Sweep the legs and catch the falling opponent's wrist under the shaft, pinning it to the ground a moment.

name: Bogripflog
description: Advance with the shaft held against the opponent's guard, pushing steadily with qi until space runs out.

name: Bostiphasp
description: Let the staff turn slowly in one hand beside the hip while qi gathers in the wrist and forearm.

name: Rightgrip Hasp
description: Spin the staff in a vertical circle beside the body, sweeping aside low cuts and kicks as it passes.

name: Tipjabswat
description: Let the spin carry the end over the shoulder to rap the opponent's collarbone on the way through.

name: Tipjabstalk
description: Step in beneath the whirl of the staff, using the spin's cover to close the gap safely.

name: Stubborn Bostip
description: Pass the staff behind the back from hand to hand, shielding the spine and changing the leading end.

name: Tipjabslap
description: Release a spinning end at full speed so the tip lashes across the opponent's wrist or ribs.

name: Guarding Bogrip
description: Whirl the staff through eight turns so the swing of the wood meets every cut, with qi held at both wrists.

name: Acrid Taperend
description: Reverse the spin's direction in the middle of a cut so the opposite end lands where the guard was not.

name: Gagging Spinbreak
description: Feed the opposing weapon into the spin and let the whirl carry it away from the opponent's hand.

name: Tipcaphasp
description: Draw a fine thread of qi from the dantian along both arms into the staff, holding it ready at the chest.

name: Grim Staffcentre
description: Send the thread forward with a single jab so that the tip arrives a fraction before the body.

name: Sturdy Roundstaff
description: Swing the shaft out to the side and let the thread stiffen it for a moment against a heavy swing.

name: Ducking Block
description: Recover from a lunge by pulling the thread back through the legs, returning to guard in half the time.

name: Tipcapslap
description: Flick the tip against the opponent's knuckles with the thread tight along the shaft for a stinging rap.

name: Braided Pivot
description: Link block, jab and sweep with one thread of qi that never leaves the staff between the three actions.

name: Gripping Rightgrip
description: Feint a thread-powered high strike, then switch the same pulse to a low rap that catches the lowered guard.

name: Sleet Staffcentre
description: Stand wide with the staff across the front and the lead hand near the end, ready to press and bind.

name: Staticbogrip
description: Rap the opponent's elbow from the inside with a short flick, loosening the arm's grip on a weapon.

name: Rill Whitewood
description: Press the staff down over an opponent's extended arm and force it toward the ground.

name: Rill Bogrip
description: Slide to the side along the pinned arm so the body ends beyond the opponent's reach.

name: Honed Tipjab
description: Drop the shaft's end sharply on the pinned wrist so the fingers open and the hand loses its hold.

name: Claytipcap
description: Lay the shaft along the pinned arm and turn it outward so the opponent cannot use the elbow.

name: Sleet Tipjab
description: Cross the shaft over both of the opponent's forearms and twist, holding them together at the chest.

name: Lurching Balancenode
description: Strike the lead leg and let the shaft's rebound catch the opponent's reaching hand against the thigh.

name: Shardbogrip
description: Stand square with the staff upright at the centre line, qi even in both arms, as every linked form begins.

name: Blockswat
description: Open the form with a single measured thrust to the centre line that tests the opponent's response.

name: Crimson Taperend
description: Raise the staff in both hands and drop it with the whole body behind the stroke, landing on the shoulder.

name: Clay Leftgrip
description: Check a flanking blow with the shaft held vertical at the hip and the body turned half away.

name: Clay Roll
description: Close the distance in a smooth pace with the staff low and level, hiding the next strike's start.

name: Rugged Bostip
description: Drive the trailing end back and up under the arm to strike an opponent who has slipped behind.

name: Sturdy Rightgrip
description: Circle the staff before the body in a slow wheel that turns aside everything aimed at the centre.

name: Principle Tipjab
description: Link a step, a thrust and a sweep as one entry, each carrying its qi into the next without a pause.

name: Draught Bogrip
description: Answer an attack with a turning parry joined to a rising strike, the two moves sharing one breath.

name: Bostipswat
description: Hold the staff's tip at the opponent's throat and advance, pressing back every step with steady qi pressure.

name: Regimen Tipcap
description: Sink into a half crouch with the staff trailing low behind, qi pooled in the thighs for the sweep.

name: Draught Whitewood
description: Reap the near end through both ankles at once in a low flat arc, aiming to take the legs.

name: Rigid Leftgrip
description: Press the shaft down across a fallen or crouching opponent's weapon arm to keep it on the ground.

name: Draught Block
description: Rise from the crouch in one step with the staff leaning on the ground, ready for the next guard.

name: Honed Sweepstep
description: Drive the near end upward from low to catch the chin of an opponent who has just lunged.

name: Rigid Bostip
description: Brace the staff across an opposing arm and the ground, holding both while qi steadies the grip.

name: Omentipcap
description: Sweep the legs, pin the arm and rise with a jab to the face, all in three connected motions.

name: Stamproll
description: Press the pinning shaft down with qi gathered at the point of contact, pinning the opponent's arm even as they strain.

name: Bogripswat
description: Spring up as the pin releases and drive the tip into the unguarded chest in one forward step.
